comparison_policy.notes: Prefer the learner's open/known languages. Add reference languages only when they reveal a useful quotation-system contrast.

experience_blueprint.notes: Start from a quotation the learner actually encountered. Compare how the same quoted speech is delimited before expanding into language/script-specific punctuation details.

discovery_policy.notes: The first eligible reviewed encounter may introduce the topic once. Content never stores or controls the visual discovery effect.

notes: Quotation marking is not assumed to be English-style punctuation. Languages and writing systems may use guillemets, corner brackets, dashes, quotation marks, spacing conventions, or other reviewed strategies; some contexts rely more heavily on layout or discourse conventions.
